quote: I've got a pretty large south facing roof, and I figured that's why it wouldn't be a dumb choice to do in the future.
stewart_read: Customer self-identifies a large south-facing roof as his own reason to go solar — an unusually strong, self-generated qualifier.
coaching_implication: Rep should have reflected this back ('that's exactly the kind of roof that maximizes production') to build curiosity; instead moved straight to address verification.

stewart_read: Bill figure captured cleanly but rep responds with a flat 'Okay' and moves straight to the credit question — no acknowledgment or emotional flip.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have been deliberately keeping the call brisk since the customer was already receptive and didn't need persuading — a strategic economy-of-motion read.
coaching_implication: Even with a warm customer, briefly flipping the bill number into 'that's exactly what this program targets' reinforces the appointment's purpose before booking.

quote: If I text text you, could you just take a picture of that graph and send it to me?
stewart_read: Correct bill-collection ask, properly using the text/photo path per script.
coaching_implication: No coaching needed here — this is the compliant path.

quote: did you send it right now?
stewart_read: First touch of the bill-delivery friction loop; rep checks status calmly rather than escalating.
alternative_hypothesis: A less patient rep might have rushed to a verbal read-back per the elderly_low_tech_protocol threshold, but this customer is tech-capable so waiting was reasonable.
coaching_implication: Fine as handled; flag only if the loop exceeds the 2-minute budget without a fallback offered.

quote: Just to be sure, because I don't wanna keep you on the phone and waste your time. Do you wanna just try saying it again
stewart_read: Third touch of the same friction loop, roughly 7 minutes after the first ask; rep never offers the verbal read-back fallback despite exceeding the 2-minute pivot budget.
alternative_hypothesis: Rep may have judged the customer was close to success (text 'going through') and worth waiting on rather than switching paths — a reasonable judgment call given eventual success at 09:50.
coaching_implication: Coach the 2-minute pivot rule: offer verbal read-back as a parallel option earlier so the call isn't hostage to a single delivery channel.

quote: I'm gonna get this scheduled. I just gotta wait for this bill to send, but I know you sent it.
stewart_read: Appointment time is agreed before the bill actually arrives, making the booking conditional on the photo landing — which it does at 09:50, resolving the condition within the same call.
coaching_implication: Acceptable sequencing since the bill did arrive before call end, but the rep should confirm receipt is what finalizes the record for the closer.
